card.name: Punctuation inside numbers starting with 1
card.fires_on: The comma or decimal point right after a leading 1 inside a dose number, such as 1,500 mg or 1.8 mg/kg. It also fires on a few digits or word starts inside trial and drug names.

modes.label: Separator after 1 in doses
modes.description: A comma or decimal point after the digit 1 in a dose amount.

modes.label: Inside trial or drug names
modes.description: A digit or word start partway through a study or brand name.

card.writes: It slightly promotes odd name-like pieces and suppresses the word risk and follow, so there is no clear link to the output.
card.plain: It fires on the comma or decimal point after a leading 1 in dose numbers like 1,500 mg or 1.8 mg/kg.
